features.drives: team / expert treatment: a team section with names, roles, and bios; expert credential framing; people surface as named nodes in the object constellation.

features.drives: knowledge section: an article/insight library with author bylines, publish dates, and reading-time metadata; author attribution links insights back to people nodes.

features.drives: credibility architecture: a results/proof section separate from services; anonymized engagements with invented outcome figures labeled as illustrations, never client names or awards.

features.drives: service discovery: a services index grouped by category (advisory, research, operations, finance, people); categories become the natural grouping key.
features.feature: practice areas (8 service objects, category field, offers)

features.drives: FAQ block: question/answer accordion sourced from article title + text.
provenance surfacing: the procedure must preserve both values and their sources instead of merging; drives an evidence/attribution treatment for contested fields.

features.drives: multi-office header/contact treatment and third-party trust signals; directory listings as verification-adjacent links.

features.drives: contact section with phone CTA, mailto, and form link; one selectable phone value with separate Call action.
